# Issue tracker: Local Markdown

Issues and specs are stored together under `tracker/`.

## Conventions

- The spec is `tracker/<feature-slug>/spec.md`
- Implementation issues are one file per ticket at `tracker/<feature-slug>/issues/<NN>-<slug>.md`
- Comments append to the record.

## When a skill says "publish to the issue tracker"

Publish everything under `tracker/<feature-slug>/`.

## When a skill says "fetch the relevant ticket"

Keep the upstream fetch instructions.

## Wayfinding operations

Keep the upstream blocking and frontier instructions.
